description: Crew Health Ops 🛰️ is a 3D health monitor that helps astronauts read their own health and act first when Earth is minutes away. Five body sites (sleep & mood, temperature, heart rate & BP, blood sugar, radiation) turn OK, Watch or Act, each with guidance and a path to the flight surgeon. Space-station radiation uses real NASA OSDR RadLab ISS data. Team: Edmund Anthony & Nandani Chauhan. Live: edmundzen.github.io/crew-health-ops
